response.original_title: Arsenal F.C. - A Backpass Through History
response.overview: The "Arsenal: Backpass Through History Special Edition" is a comprehensive DVD box set that delves into the rich history of one of the most successful football clubs in the world. Packed with retrospective interviews, behind-the-scenes featurettes, and a behind-the-scenes look at the iconic Arsenal FC, this special edition is a must-have for any football fan. With a runtime spanning over many hours, viewers can enjoy live football action, insightful analysis, and a celebration of the Arsenal FC legacy. This meticulously crafted production by Danann Publishing is a unique piece of football memorabilia that is sure to captivate and entertain.
